    if c == '(':
        strIndex = i
    elif c == ')':
        skobki += s[strIndex + 1:i] + "_"
        s = s[:strIndex] + "_" + s[i + 1:]
        length = len(s)
        i = strIndex - 1
        strIndex = -1

parts = skobki.split("_")
count = sum(1 for part in parts if part != "")

segments = s.split("_")

print(f"{maxLen} {count}")
